One DBAASP IC50 row note says CRE E. faecium C33105 while primary Table 1 labels the isolate vancomycin-resistant E. faecium; activity value and isolate match, note conflict preserved.

The OA package supplement PDF was checked; it contains growth-condition Table S1, purification/methods, and supplementary figures, not a separate activity table that changes Table 1 Haloduracin activity rows.
The paper frames lipid II targeting as likely from structural/mutant context; final mechanism keeps direct claims to synergy, sequential action, membrane depolarization, and potassium efflux assays.
